question: Which global chip‑design conference, returning to San Francisco in June 2025, for its 62ⁿd edition, announced a GenAI Chip Hackathon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DAC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Design Automation Conference (DAC):** The **DAC** is one of the most prominent global conferences in the field of **electronic design automation (EDA)**. It focuses on design methodologies, tools, and technologies for chip design and systems.
 
• The **62nd edition** of DAC is scheduled to be held in **June 2025** in **San Francisco**. This is a significant event in the technology and chip-design industry, attracting professionals, researchers, and students globally.
 
• The announcement of the **GenAI Chip Hackathon** at DAC highlights the conference's dedication to innovative and cutting-edge technologies. The hackathon is expected to address challenges in chip design using **Generative AI (GenAI)**. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• **DAC's significance:** DAC serves as a platform for showcasing advancements in **EDA tools**, chip-design methodologies, and new research ideas. It also encourages collaboration between academia and industry.
 
• The inclusion of a **hackathon** at DAC demonstrates the growing importance of **AI-driven solutions** in chip design and system optimization. This aligns with the industry’s shift towards integrating **AI technologies** for enhanced performance and efficiency. *Hence, DAC is the correct answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **DAC Overview:**

 
 
• The **Design Automation Conference (DAC)** is one of the oldest and most prestigious conferences in the field of **chip design**. It began in **1964** and has grown to become a global event attracting industry leaders, innovators, and researchers.
 
• DAC covers topics related to **EDA tools, semiconductor design, machine learning applications in chip design**, and system optimization. The conference includes workshops, panels, and keynote sessions.
 
 
 
• **Generative AI in Chip Design:**
 
 
• **Generative AI (GenAI):** This technology employs AI models to generate solutions for complex design problems. In chip design, GenAI can assist in automating tasks such as **layout creation, optimization, and verification.**
 
• The integration of **GenAI** technologies into chip design processes is expected to reduce development time, improve efficiency, and enable innovation in semiconductor technologies.
 
 
 
• **Notable DAC Features:**
 
 
• The conference offers a unique blend of **academic research presentations** and industry exhibits showcasing state-of-the-art tools and technologies.
 
• The addition of events like the **GenAI Chip Hackathon** reflects the growing emphasis on interdisciplinary approaches to chip design and development.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Comparison of Options:**

 
 
• **ICCAD:** The **International Conference on Computer-Aided Design** focuses on EDA methodologies but does not typically host chip hackathons. Hence, this is not the correct answer.
 
• **ISSCC:** The **International Solid-State Circuits Conference** concentrates on advancements in circuit designs and systems but does not focus on automation or hackathons related to GenAI. Hence, this is not the correct answer.
 
• **Hot Chips:** This conference emphasizes the presentation of high-performance chips and architectures but does not focus on EDA tools or hackathons. Hence, this is not the correct answer.
 
 
 
• **Future Trends:**
 
 
• The integration of **AI technologies** like GenAI into chip design will shape the future of the semiconductor industry, enabling faster development and smarter designs.
 
• Events like the **GenAI Chip Hackathon** serve as platforms for innovation and skill development, preparing the industry for emerging challenges and opportunities.
